intermediate_harness_correction.meaning: All six failing cancellation assertions came from the test's fixed clock differing from the shared cancellation helper's real clock. Injected the same clock into both helpers; production time handling was unchanged.

preflight_notes: The unsupported Node json reporter exited before tests; TAP was used instead.
The unsupported Deno cached-only flag was replaced after reading CLI help.
A native-client package download attempt failed. The verified HTTPS proxy/CA path was reused without relaxing TLS; pinned lock remained unchanged.
